questions: What does a mask do?
If you take off the mask, does everything become visible?
What is a buffer?
If the buffer is empty, does the process have to stop?
What is a track?
If the track ends, has the movement stopped?
What is a scene?
When the scene changes, has the place changed?
What does precision mean?
If precision improves, is the result necessarily closer to the truth?
What is scale?
If the scale gets larger, does the area shown get larger too?
What is resolution?
If the resolution is increased, can you see smaller things?
What is a tile?
If a tile is missing, is there a hole?
What is a cloud?
If the cloud gets denser, can you see less through it?
What is a fence?
If the fence is crossed, is anything physically stopped?
What is orientation?
If the orientation flips, has the area itself turned around?
What is a projection?
If the projection shifts, does what you see shift with it?
What is a feature?
If a feature is removed, is anything actually gone?
What is an extent?
If the extent gets bigger, has the object grown?
What is a footprint?
If the footprint gets bigger, did something take a bigger step?
